description: Address 5 review issues: feed cache invalidation on ban, saved-posts totalItems comment, compound index migration safety, redundant source field removal, and CommunityInterest double-fetch fix.
steps: Step 1: In admin.service.js, import invalidateCache and call it after user status update
Step 2: In user.service.js getSavedPosts, add explanatory comment about totalItems discrepancy
Step 3: In communityWaitlist.model.js, remove unique:true from compound indexes
Step 4: In community.controller.js registerInterest, remove source: type from create calls
Step 5: In CommunityInterest.tsx, fix double-fetch by removing activeType from useEffect deps
acceptance_criteria: admin.service.js imports and calls invalidateCache after status update
user.service.js has explanatory comment about totalItems behavior
communityWaitlist.model.js indexes are non-unique for migration safety
community.controller.js does not write source: type in create calls
CommunityInterest.tsx useEffect only fires on mount, not on activeType change
